cues.en: The plot of a derivative in general looks nothing like the plot of its original function.
cues.zh: 一般來說，導數的圖和原函數的圖，一點也不像。

cues.en: Of course, the function and the derivative are closely related to each other, and you will soon learn how to differentiate different functions.
cues.zh: 當然，函數和導數密切相關，你也很快會學到怎麼對不同函數微分。

cues.en: But the graph of the derivative generally doesn't look like the graph of the function.
cues.zh: 但導數圖通常不像函數圖。

cues.en: And even more importantly, when you look at the graph of a function and the graph of the derivative, you're actually looking for two different things.
cues.zh: 更重要的是，看函數圖和導數圖時，其實是在找兩種不同的東西。

cues.en: You're looking for different things in the graph.
cues.zh: 你在圖裡觀察的內容不同。

cues.en: So that means that interpreting derivatives plots is different from interpreting the graph of a function.
cues.zh: 所以解讀導數圖，和解讀函數圖不一樣。

cues.en: Now, it's a little weird at first to interpret derivatives plots.
cues.zh: 一開始解讀導數圖，會有點奇怪。

cues.en: It takes some getting used to take some practice.
cues.zh: 需要習慣、需要練習。

cues.en: And so in this video, I'm going to introduce you to interpreting derivatives plots.
cues.zh: 所以這支影片，我要介紹如何解讀導數圖。

cues.en: Now, the most important thing to remember about derivatives plots is that you're looking at the slopes of the function at each point.
cues.zh: 看導數圖最重要的一點，是記得你看的是函數在每個點的斜率。

cues.en: You're not looking at the value of the function.
cues.zh: 不是函數的值。

cues.en: That's the graph of the function.
cues.zh: 那是函數圖呈現的。

cues.en: When you look at the plot of the derivative, you're looking at the slope of the tangent line through that function, not the function value, not the intercept of the tangent line, just the slope of the
cues.zh: 看導數圖時，看的是穿過函數的切線斜率，不是函數值，也不是切線的截距，只是切線的

cues.en: tangent line.
cues.zh: 斜率。

cues.en: I know that this may seem obvious after the past few videos, but it's an important point to keep in mind because, well, because you are going to get confused when you look at derivatives plots.
cues.zh: 經過前幾支影片，你可能覺得這很明顯，但仍然要記住，因為看導數圖時，你一定會混淆。

cues.en: So more generally, what do you look for in a derivative plot?
cues.zh: 更一般地說，導數圖應該看什麼？

cues.en: Well, the derivative plot reveals many interesting features of the function that you will learn about throughout this course.
cues.zh: 導數圖揭露函數許多有趣的特徵，你會在整門課逐步學到。
